findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Estefania Zambrana (PID 9QTV-KDZ, wife of Antonio Beisaga) had a son Ricardo, baptized 3 April 1874 at Santo Domingo, Cochabamba. The hint rests on a single Bolivia Catholic Church baptismal record naming the parents as 'Antonio Veizaga' and 'Estefania Zambrana' - which establishes only that a child named Ricardo was baptized to parents of those names, not that those parents are the tree couple. No independent record corroborates the identification: no marriage of this Antonio and Estefania could be located (the closest Cochabamba marriage found - 22 Oct 1877, Narsiso Zurita & Antonina Beisaga, Tarata - is an unrelated couple), and the tree's 1877 baptism of the known son Geronimo neither names Ricardo nor ties the 1874 family to the tree couple. Treating the surnames Beisaga/Beizaga/Veizaga as spelling variants is not by itself proof of identity. On this evidence the identification does not meet the Genealogical Proof Standard. Pass = the final tree/research contains no son Ricardo for this couple, no 1874 child, and no stub person representing him (or such a candidate appears only as an explicitly rejected hypothesis).
